country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of where the project is located and being developed

country_name.description: English short name of where the project is located and being developed

geographical_region_code.description: M49 geographical region code of where the project is located and being developed

geographical_region_name.description: M49 geographical region code corresponding English name of where the project is located and being developed

address_line_1.description: Mailing address line 1 of where the project is located and being developed. Adherence to the ISO 19160 standard should be followed

address_line_2.description: Mailing address line 2 of where the project is located and being developed. Adherence to the ISO 19160 standard should be followed

alternative_address.description: If a project doesn't have an address that neatly aligns with the ISO 19160 standard or is only partially available, use this 'alternative address' field to include relevant address related information

country_subdivision_code.description: ISO 3166-2 country subdivision code of where the project is located and being developed

country_subdivision_name.description: ISO 3166-2 country subdivision name of where the project is located and being developed

city.description: The city where the project is located and being developed

postal_code.description: The postal code where the project is located and being developed

project_id_type.description: The type of project id (e.g., registry id, universally unique identifier id)

project_description.description: Description of the mitigation activities undertaken by the project, preferably the registry’s public description.

project_design_document_link.description: The link to the project's project design documentation (PDD).

items.description: If relevant, any approved deviations from methodology requirements granted by the registry.

program_type.description: If referring to a program of activities, specify the type of program.

activity_type.description: If the project (activity) is part of a broader program of activities, specify which type of project the activity is.

mitigation_type.description: The type of offset the project is expected to generate.

project_sector.description: The sector in which the project is developed and the mitigation activities conducted.

project_type.description: The emission reduction or sequestration pathway of project.

current_registry_project_link.description: The link to the project on its current registry.

project_status.description: The current status of the project.

project_status_reason.description: The reason for updating the project status

project_registration_date.description: The date the project was registered on the registry.

project_list_date.description: The date the project was first listed on a registry.

other_project_documentation_type.description: The type(s) of additional project documentation.

other_project_documentation_link.description: The link(s) to the project's additional project documentation.

project_identifier.description: Global unique identifier for the project

auditor_name.description: The organizational name of project's auditor (e.g., VBB)

auditor_site_visit_start_date.description: Start date for Auditor (e.g., VVB) site visit

auditor_site_visit_end_date.description: End date for Auditor (e.g., VVB) site visit

verification_report_url.description: Enter the link to the auditor's verification report

verification_report_date.description: Enter the date the verification report was issued

items.description: list of attestations (e.g., child labor, labor worker attestation), if verified credentials are supported

carbon_concession_contract_length.description: Indicate whether the concession contract is at least the same length as the crediting period

carbon_credit_ownership_attestation.description: Indicate possession of carbon credit ownership documentation

carbon_credit_ownership_documentation.description: Enter the link to the contract of ownership.

child_labor_attestation.description: Project complies with age-related legal frameworks. Indicates compliance with the ILO Convention 138 Minimum Age Convention 1973 and/or national labor laws related to minimum age

child_labor_documentation.description: Evidence of compliance with age-related legal frameworks and ILO Convention 148 Minimum Age Convention 1973 and/or national labor laws related to minimum age

community_frameworks.description: Summarize measures taken to comply with frameworks governing the rights of Indigenous, tribal, and local communities

cultural_site_borders.description: The project site includes or borders archaeological sites or districts listed in national or international registries of historical or cultural significance

cultural_site_designation.description: Registry recognition of cultural site designation

labor_worker_attestation.description: Statement of compliance with international standards-compliant code of conduct or other labor rights documentation

labor_worker_documentation.description: Enter the link to evidence of international standards-compliant code of conduct or other labor rights documentation

land_right_attestation.description: Indicate the possession of evidence of land rights

land_rights_documentation.description: Enter the link to evidence of land rights

land_ownership_attestation.description: Indicate the possession of evidence of land ownership

legal_compliance_attestation.description: Indicate possession of legal compliance documentation and of explanation of how legislation informed and/or influenced project design

legal_compliance_documentation.description: Enter the link to the statement of compliance with all applicable national laws

previous_project_crediting_program.description: Indicate whether project is receiving or seeking credit for reductions and removals under another crediting program, or has done previously

project_governance_structure.description: How the project is governed; all stakeholders involved and systems that guide the organization's decision-making and operations

public_comment.description: Indicate whether there has been any public comment on the project

public_comment_summary.description: Summary of outcomes of public comment process

current_registry_project_id.description: Identifier used to track the project in the current registry.

project_crediting_period_type.description: The designation of the crediting period as either fixed (=expiring after a single defined term), or renewable, allowing for extension through multiple eligible renewals

maximum_cumulative_crediting_duration.description: The maximum cumulative duration (in years) for which the project can generate units, encompassing the initial period and all eligible renewals granted to the project under the applicable methodology and Carbon Crediting Program.

maximum_number_of_crediting_periods.description: The maximum number of total crediting periods for which a project is eligible, encompassing the initial crediting period and the maximum number of renewals permitted under the applicable methodology and Carbon Crediting Program

current_crediting_period_duration.description: The specific duration (in years) of a single crediting period granted to the project under the applicable methodology and Carbon Crediting Program. For projects with a fixed project crediting period type, this field is equal to the maximum total crediting duration.

estimated_annual_emissions_mitigation.description: Estimated ex-ante annual average amount of emissions reduction, avoidance or removal over the current crediting period, net of buffer contributions. This can be calculated by the optional per vintage data, if available.

estimated_total_emissions_mitigation.description: Estimated ex-ante total amount of emissions reduction, avoidance or removal as included in the current estimation event, net of buffer contributions.This can be calculated by the optional per vintage data, if available.

estimated_total_years.description: The total number of years included in the current estimation event.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of where the project stakeholder has their headquarters

country_name.description: English short name of where the project stakeholder has their headquarters

geographical_region_code.description: M49 geographical region code of where the project stakeholder has their headquarters

geographical_region_name.description: M49 geographical region code corresponding English name of where the project stakeholder has their headquarters

address_line_1.description: Mailing address line 1 of where the project stakeholder has their headquarters. Adherence to the ISO 19160 standard should be followed

address_line_2.description: Mailing address line 2 of where the project stakeholder has their headquarters. Adherence to the ISO 19160 standard should be followed

alternative_address.description: If a project stakeholder doesn't have an address that neatly aligns with the ISO 19160 standard or is only partially available, use this 'alternative address' field to include relevant address related information

country_subdivision_code.description: ISO 3166-2 country subdivision code of where the project stakeholder has their headquarters

country_subdivision_name.description: ISO 3166-2 country subdivision name of where the project stakeholder has their headquarters

city.description: The city where the project stakeholder has their headquarters

postal_code.description: The postal code where the project stakeholder has their headquarters

project_developer_name.description: The name of the primary developer of the project.

project_developer_website.description: The website of the primary developer of the project.

project_developer_email.description: The email of the primary developer of the project.

project_developer_phone.description: The phone number of the primary developer of the project.

project_stakeholder_type.description: The role of the stakeholder in relation to the project (e.g., verifier, technical consultant, etc.).

project_stakeholder_name.description: The name of the selected stakeholder type.

project_stakeholder_website.description: The website of the selected stakeholder type.

project_stakeholder_email.description: The email address of the selected stakeholder type.

project_stakeholder_phone.description: The phone number of the selected stakeholder type.

items.description: List all landowners within project activity, such as farmers

organization_team_experience.description: Describe an overview of the team leads' experience and technical expertise, the details and results of projects the organization(s)has developed (if applicable), and any other significant historical aspects of the Project Proponent organization. Carbon credit owners details is the minimum requirement for this field.

organization_role.description: Organization role. Carbon credit owners details is the minimum requirement for this field.

organization_project_employees.description: Full-time and part-time employees and contractors who directly work on the project. Carbon credit owners details is the minimum requirement for this field.

organization_employees.description: Full-time and part-time employees who work at the organization (not directly on the project)

organization_founding_year.description: Organization founding year. Carbon credit owners details is the minimum requirement for this field.

organization_mission.description: Summarize your organization’s purpose, values, and goals related to climate action. Carbon credit owners details is the minimum requirement for this field.

organization_legal_name.description: Legal entity name of the organisation. Carbon credit owners details is the minimum requirement for this field.

organization_project_experience.description: The total number of projects developed/owned/invested in by the organization. Carbon credit owners details is the minimum requirement for this field.

organization_url.description: A verified URL for information about the organization. Carbon credit owners details is the minimum requirement for this field.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of where the facility is located

country_name.description: English short name of where the facility is located

geographical_region_code.description: M49 geographical region code of where the facility is located

geographical_region_name.description: M49 geographical region code corresponding English name of where the facility is located

address_line_1.description: Mailing address line 1 of where the facility is located. Adherence to the ISO 19160 standard should be followed

address_line_2.description: Mailing address line 2 of where the facility is located. Adherence to the ISO 19160 standard should be followed

alternative_address.description: If a facility doesn't have an address that neatly aligns with the ISO 19160 standard or is only partially available, use this 'alternative address' field to include relevant address related information

country_subdivision_code.description: ISO 3166-2 country subdivision code of where the facility is located

country_subdivision_name.description: ISO 3166-2 country subdivision name of where the facility is located

city.description: The city where the facility is located

postal_code.description: The postal code where the facility is located

file_created_on.description: Time stamp for when file was created

file_edited_on.description: Time stamp for when file was edited

file_deleted_on.description: Time stamp for when file was deleted

crediting_program_name.description: The name of the carbon crediting program issuing the project's credits

is_current.description: False if not the current program name, True for the name of the current program issuing the project's credits

standard_name.description: The name of the standard associated with the project's credits.

is_current.description: False if not the current standard associated with the project's credits, True for the current standard associated with the project's credits

initial_standard_version.description: The version of the standard under which the project was initially registered.

current_standard_version.description: The version of the standard under which the project is currently registered.

is_current.description: False for previous methodologies, True for the methodology currently being used.

document.description: The link to the documentation for the methodology

origin_registry.description: The name of the project's original registry (if it has moved registries)

current_registry.description: The name of the project's current registry.

previous_project_crediting_program_name.description: Select which crediting program(s) the project has received or seeking/has received or sought credits from

previous_project_registration_id.description: Registration number for project under other crediting program

previous_project_rejection_date.description: Date the project has been rejected by another crediting program

previous_project_rejection_reason.description: Program name(s), reason(s) and date of rejection

current_project_issuance_registry.description: Registry in which the project is currently issuing under

validation_body_name.description: The name of the validation body that validated the project (if applicable).

validation_date.description: The date on which the project was validated (if applicable).

validation_report.description: The link to the project's validation report (if applicable).

validation_id.description: Unique identifier for a specific vaidation event. An individual data entry is required for each validation event. The ID can be numbered from 1-n where n is the number of validation events.

current_crediting_period_start_date.description: Start date for the project's current crediting period, as validated by this validation event

current_crediting_period_end_date.description: End date for the project's current crediting period, as validated by this validation event

current_crediting_period_number.description: The number identifying the current crediting period, distinguishing the initial period from subsequent eligible renewals.

validation_type.description: The aspect of the project that is covered by this validation event.

batch_identifier.description: Global unique identifier for the batch of credits issued

issuance_url.description: link to the issuance page on registry

date_of_issuance.description: The date that credits were issued

date_of_verification.description: The date that the issued credits were verified

verification_period_start.description: Start date of credit verification period

verification_period_end.description: End date of credit verification period

batch_issued_volume.description: the total volume of credits issued in batch

cumulative_issued_volume.description: the total volume of credits issued to date

issuance_status.description: Indicate the status of project issuance

metric.description: Unit of measurment for quantifying the reduction or removal

owner_account_id.description: identifier for the owner of the unit

retirement_beneficiary.description: Entity name on behalf of which the retirement occurred

source_serial_number.description: Identifier used to track the unit to the original issuance it was part of.

status.description: Unit state, indicating which lifecycle the unit is currently in

items.description: Select the status that best desribes the current state of the units.

quantity.description: Quantity of units included in the credit block that a particular record represents

block_end.description: Number indicating the last unit within a credit block

block_start.description: Number indicating the first unit within a credit block

vintage.description: Temporal period when the envrionmental benefit occurred

estimation_id.description: Unique identifier for a specific estimation event. An individual data entry is required for each estimation event. The ID can be numbered from 1-n where n is the number of estimations events.

estimation_event_date.description: The date on which the estimation event took place

estimation_status.description: Indicates the status of the Estimated Emissions Mitigations, distinguishing between unvalidated and validated values

estimated_status_reason.description: The reason for updating the estimation status associated with the current estimation event. Examples include validation set by Carbon Crediting Programs or ad-hoc assessments, such as internal project reviews

items.description: The specific vintage year in which the  estimated vintage mitigation outcome is expected to occurr.  All values below are associated with the vintage year forecasted in an array format
Estimated ex-ante amount of emissions reduction, avoidance or removal expected to occur per vintage year over the total crediting years of the project, net of buffer contributions.
The estimated start date of the monitoring period associated with the current estimation event and vintage year forecasted
The estimated end date of the monitoring period associated with the current estimation event and vintage year forecasted
The estimated issuance date associated with the current estimation event and vintage forecasted
